name: Deepsight
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (small fragment of obsidian)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Deepsight extends a subject’s darkvision (whether natural or from the darkvision spell), by an additional 60 feet.
